registered_note: Written and committed BEFORE any model generated a single witness. The authoritative timestamp is this file's git commit.
data: data/witness_train.jsonl positives (n=50: VULNERABLE programs with an oracle-confirmed, reproduced witness from the Phase-A deterministic capture). 2-fold cross-fitting by sha1(id) % 2: each adapter trains on the positives outside its fold and scores only its fold, so every one of the 198 programs is scored by a model that never saw it.
score: per program: 1 iff the model's witness is confirmed by exec_oracle routed to the program's CWE oracle AND reproduced by a second independent run; else 0. CWEs with no runtime monitor (oracle 'none') score 0.

hypotheses.H2_primary_beats_no_model_baseline: AUROC(fine-tuned, cross-fitted) - AUROC(deterministic no-model witnesses, same 198 programs) > 2 x paired-bootstrap SE (B=2000)
hypotheses.H1_finetuning_teaches_witnessing: AUROC(fine-tuned) - AUROC(same base model zero-shot, same prompt, same programs) > 2 x paired-bootstrap SE
hypotheses.H3_beats_fuzzer_floor: AUROC(fine-tuned) - AUROC(fuzzer floor results/imp_2o_floor_b60.json, same programs) > 2 x paired-bootstrap SE

claims: Only H2 PASS supports 'the model beats execution without a model'. H1 alone means fine-tuning taught the witness protocol, not that the model beats a template list. H3 alone is weaker than H2 because the deterministic baseline already includes the floor's empty input. No claim leaves the repo without integrity (stored AUROC == recomputed from per_case) and an experiment-auditor pass.
disclosed: The deterministic Phase-A capture and its AUROC (0.7323 routed, vs floor 0.7172 on the same programs) were seen before this bar was written; no model output existed.
The CWE is given in the prompt (from the CASTLE file name, present for SAFE and VULNERABLE alike), exactly as the deterministic baseline uses it.
Train and eval programs share CWE families (CASTLE siblings), so this measures within-family generalisation, not unseen-class generalisation.
Positives are dominated by empty-input witnesses (40/50); a model can match the baseline by learning 'empty input' and the four CANARY templates.

train_hparams.quant: 4-bit NF4 QLoRA on the box GPU
